text: 中国上证综指11月12日（周四）收盘下跌24.81点，跌幅：0.67%，报3655.83点；中国深证成指11月12日（周四）收盘下跌191.76点，跌幅：1.68%，报11197.98点；中国沪深300指数11月12日（周四）收盘下跌31.78点，跌幅：0.78%，报4043.93点；中国创业板指数11月12日（周四）收盘下跌62.64点，跌幅：2.44%，报2509.43点；中国科创50指数11月12日（周四）收盘上涨9.46点，涨幅：0.73%，报1309.84点。
text_en: China's Shanghai Composite Index closed down 24.81 points, or 0.67%, at 3,655.83 points on Thursday, November 12; China's Shenzhen Component Index closed down 191.76 points, or 1.68%, at 11,197.98 points on Thursday, November 12; China's CSI 300 Index closed down 31.78 points, or 0.78%, at 4,043.93 points on Thursday, November 12; China's ChiNext Index closed down 62.64 points, or 2.44%, at 2,509.43 points on Thursday, November 12; China's STAR 50 Index closed up 9.46 points, or 0.73%, at 1,309.84 points on Thursday, November 12.
